description: For an agent (L8 or above) or one of its bound wallets: priced stablecoin and token balances and ETH in USD at one block, the EIP-7702 delegate if any with its code hash and known sweeper family, and the open ERC-20 allowances the wallet granted, confirmed on chain and capped at the balance per token (agent.blast_radius.v1). Read every six hours from free public nodes. A measurement of exposure at one block, not a prediction; unpriced tokens are listed by symbol.
